title: Deep Sea Exploration
tagline: Venturing from the surface to the abyss.

events.title: The Challenger Expedition
events.text: The HMS Challenger sails on the first global oceanographic expedition, founding the science of oceanography.

events.title: First deep-sea descent
events.text: William Beebe and Otis Barton descend in a bathysphere, taking humans to then-unprecedented depths.

events.title: The deepest point is reached
events.text: Jacques Piccard and Don Walsh descend to the bottom of the Mariana Trench in the bathyscaphe Trieste — about 10,916 m down.

events.title: Hydrothermal vents discovered
events.text: Scientists aboard the submersible Alvin discover deep-sea hydrothermal vents and their astonishing ecosystems.

events.title: The wreck of the Titanic is found
events.text: Robert Ballard and colleagues locate the Titanic 3,800 m down, demonstrating deep mapping and spawning modern deep-sea archaeology.

events.title: James Cameron returns to the trench
events.text: James Cameron pilots the DEEPSEA CHALLENGER solo to the bottom of the Mariana Trench, the first single-person descent.

events.title: The Five Deeps Expedition
events.text: The Five Deeps expedition maps all five of Earth’s deepest ocean trenches, two years ahead of schedule.
